name: SpaWellnessAppointmentBook
tagline: Run a hotel spa from one control: therapist & room day book, packages, guest preferences and charge to room.
description: A complete hotel spa & wellness app for Power Apps and Power Pages. Reception sees KPIs and next arrivals, books single treatments or packages, drags bookings between therapists and rooms with double-booking protection, checks guests in and posts treatments to the guest folio with manager approval above a limit.
features: Therapist and room double-booking checks with reset buffer
Spa packages expanded into back-to-back itineraries
Therapist gender preference and room-type warnings
Status workflow with business rules and undo
Bulk confirm, check-in, posting, assignment and CSV export
Demo mode with fictional spa data
